article: Mac mini (2018) used purchase and iOS development setup
scope: Compared the complete Japanese source and twelve translations, hardware configuration, purchase context, software versions, metadata dates, image links, and current Apple compatibility information.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date in all 13 files; retained 2023-04-02 and set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Corrected IntelliJ IDEA spelling and product capitalization across locales.
Added a dated note explaining that the article is a historical personal purchase record, and describing current Tahoe 26 and Xcode 27 compatibility limits for Intel Macs.
Added Apple primary references for hardware specs, OS compatibility, Xcode requirements, and Intel support.
